טבלה: רכב חלופי
This table details the conditions for receiving a replacement vehicle (רכב חלופי) following an accident or theft. It specifies time limits and requirements for eligibility, such as submitting a claim within 14 days.
ממדים: Conditions for alternative vehicle service, Time limits, eligibility criteria, and service provisions

B. Limitations
In any event the alternative vehicle service will not be provided unless a demand th is submitted to the service provider no later than the 14 day after the occurrence of the accident or theft.
The alternative vehicle service will be provided subject to actual repair of the vehicle as a result of the accident in accordance with the number of days
However, in any event the vehicle will not be provided for a period exceeding 7 days (unless otherwise noted in the policy specification) and subject to non-receipt of an alternative vehicle from another entity in respect of the same occurrence.
In the event of an accident where the damage sustained by the insured vehicle is defined by the surveyor as a total loss, the alternative vehicle will be provided for 7 days, unless otherwise noted in the insurance policy.
No alternative vehicle services will be provided in the event of an accident emanating from engagement in competitive sport.
In the event of theft -in accordance with the following conditions (if theft cover is purchased in the insurance policy):
In the event of theft of the insured vehicle, the service provider th shall provide an alternative vehicle from the 8 day (unless otherwise noted in the insurance policy) after a notice is given to the police and the insurance company regarding theft of the vehicle, and until the vehicle is found or until the compensation is received from the insurance company, the earlier of the two.
In any event an alternative vehicle will not be provided to the th client before the 8 day (unless otherwise noted in the insurance th policy) and not beyond the 30 day (unless otherwise noted in the insurance policy) after the date the notice is given to the police in regard to the theft, not beyond the date of receipt of payment from the insurance company, and not for a period exceeding 23 days (unless otherwise noted in the insurance policy) subject to paragraph b1 hereunder.
The insured undertakes to return the alternative vehicle to the car hire company immediately after the vehicle is located or receipt of the notice regarding finding the vehicle and/or its remnants and/or receipt of compensation from the insurance company (the earlier of them).
In the event that it becomes apparent that the insured vehicle which was stolen was also involved in an accident, the insured will be entitled to an alternative vehicle as noted in paragraph 'a' above.
determined in the surveyor's report, and in any event the service will not be provided after the vehicle is repaired due to the accident.
The insured shall not be entitled to more than one alternative vehicle service free of charge in respect of an occurrence or series of occurrences which are related to each other by a causal connection.
In total all the car hire days provided in the course of the insurance period shall not exceed 30 days (unless otherwise noted in the insurance policy).
The eligibility days will be provided continuously and may not be split.
In the event that the insured is referred to the car hire company by the service provider and it fails to realize his entitlement to the alternative vehicle, his entitlement to the alternative vehicle for that occurrence shall lapse. In order to avoid any doubt, receipt of the alternative vehicle will be possible only if 14 days have not yet elapsed since the occurrence and on condition that the vehicle has not been repaired due to the accident.
